subject: The Strongest Signal card — what Pros actually look at
preview_text: It hits 88% on Elite-tier matches. Most users don't even open it.
body_paragraphs: Quick Pro tip you may have missed: on every prediction screen, scroll past the match result and find the 'Strongest Signal' card. It's the calibrated double-chance pick — and on Elite-tier matches, it has hit ~88% historically.
How to use it: when the tier badge says Elite or Premium, the Strongest Signal is the safest call. When it says Standard, treat it as a starting point and look at the other markets too.
